usedFor: JustCall holds the calls and texts, and Documint receives content through “Add Content To Template” after “Call Updated”.

bestTemplate.name: “Call Updated” in JustCall, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Call notes are the content worth putting in a document, and “Call Updated” fires when they change.

watchOut: “Call Updated” fires each time notes change, so “Add Content To Template” can run more than once per call.
